name: Raspberry Red Lips Macro Grid
image_vibe: warm berry luxury, crisp editorial texture
image_purpose: beauty campaign concept and product texture board

prompt.project_info: Create a consistent 2x2 macro beauty grid with berry-red makeup, natural skin texture, and fresh raspberries as a still-life prop.
prompt.main_subject: The same clearly adult fictional woman across all four panels, with natural pores and faint freckles, sleek dark hair, hazel-brown eyes, dusty rose blush, sharp eyeliner, separated lashes, and deep berry-red glossy lipstick; lips remain relaxed and closed.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 2x2 grid: eye-cheek-lips crops with raspberries held beside the cheek or lower face, never in the mouth and never touching the lips; minimal warm-neutral studio background, thin gutter, consistent identity, makeup, and styling.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional studio light from the side, medium-soft contrast, warm-neutral temperature, controlled gloss highlights, soft shadow falloff, subtle film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 100mm macro lens, f/2.8, shallow but legible depth of field, editorial-crisp detail, light retouching with high texture preservation, no HDR or plastic skin.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-fashion 2x2 macro beauty editorial grid featuring the same clearly adult fictional woman in every panel, natural pores and faint freckles, sleek dark hair, hazel-brown eyes, dusty rose blush, sharp winged eyeliner, deep berry-red glossy lipstick with relaxed closed lips, fresh raspberries held beside the cheek or lower face without mouth contact, warm-neutral minimal studio, soft side light, 100mm macro at f/2.8, subtle film grain, 4:5, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, open-mouth pose, raspberry in mouth, food on lips, lip biting, tongue, sexualized framing, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: raspberry macro grid reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the 2x2 layout, berry-red makeup, natural skin texture, warm background, and berry prop scale; keep identity, crop variations, berry placement, and wardrobe replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the grid structure and beauty-campaign intent, but place raspberries beside the face with closed lips for a nonsexual still-life interaction. Keep the fictional adult identity consistent across panels.

policy_review.changes: Replaced sensual mouth contact with berries held beside the face and specified relaxed closed lips; clarified the subject as a fictional adult.
policy_review.notes: Food styling remains nonsexual and product-editorial.
